state: Confused about what is happening to him
objective: Reduce uncertainty and supply an accurate, usable model — not 'use masculine language'
appraisal: This is intelligible and someone has a map.
emotion: Curiosity, calm, quiet relief from disorientation
linguistic: Everyday description first, clinical term second and optional; one mechanism per piece; short declaratives.
failureMode: Diagnosing the reader; stacking clinical jargon; false certainty.

state: Knows something is wrong; responding would expose him
objective: Lower the social and exposure cost of the first move
appraisal: Nobody has to know, and I can stop anytime.
linguistic: Explicit privacy statements; explicit permission to say nothing; reversible low-threshold action.
failureMode: Vagueness disguised as low pressure; a privacy promise the service cannot keep.

state: Believes it is entirely his fault and he has failed
objective: Describe the situation accurately without supplying a culprit
appraisal: That is my exact situation, and they didn't need an enemy to say it.
emotion: Feeling deeply seen; grief surfacing safely without shame
linguistic: Concrete situational detail over emotion words; second person or unattributed third person; no CTA.
failureMode: Grievance amplification; blaming women, feminism, or 'society' as the scapegoat.

state: Wants to act, but doesn't know how
objective: Provide one available, performable, reversible step
appraisal: That is small enough to do right now.
emotion: Motivation, calm self-efficacy, relief from paralysis
linguistic: One step only; verifiable; cost, time, and friction stated honestly.
failureMode: Recommending a step that is not actually available (e.g. 6-hour Puskesmas queues).

state: Surrounded by peers, but confides in none
objective: Make the room and community legible before asking anyone to walk in
appraisal: I know exactly what happens if I walk in there.
emotion: Warmth, recognition, feeling expected without spotlight
linguistic: Describe the physical room and logistics, not the feeling; state that sitting quietly is allowed.
failureMode: Asserting fake 'brotherhood'; using 'kita' before a real relationship exists.

state: Social standing already under severe strain
objective: Preserve adult dignity; do not re-anchor worth to provision
appraisal: Engaging here does not cost me my manhood or standing.
linguistic: Assume competence; avoid achievement framing; avoid 'real men' or provider pressure.
failureMode: Provider framing — annihilating for the men most at risk.

appraisal: I know exactly what to do right now.
linguistic: Plain, unhedged, no metaphor, no humor, explicit numbers and crisis steps.
failureMode: Autonomy-preserving hedging; euphemism; anything requiring interpretive effort.
